notes:
High-level: mid-market SaaS (product-driven features for embedded chat + intelligent search) — currently on an OpenAI-first stack. Interested in Redwood Hosted as a migration path with eventual Dedicated reserved capacity for production.

Key priorities (customer quoted): "We need parity — prompts must behave the same, embeddings mustn't drift, and tail latency must meet SLAs."

POC scope: migrate one chat endpoint + one embedding pipeline to Redwood Hosted. Run a three-pronged parity/regression plan: (1) unit prompt parity tests (tokenization, function-call signatures), (2) fuzzy-output regression suite (BLEU/embedding-similarity thresholds), (3) load stability (95th-p99 latency under 120ms target for chat; embeddings QPS 80 sustained).

Compatibility notes: Helmstone uses an OpenAI-compat wrapper plus custom prompt templating and post-processing. Their concerns: different function-calling semantics and system message handling, plus subtle output differences when model or sampling seeds differ. They asked about a Redwood "compat shim" and mapping guidelines. We demoed Redwood's catalog mapping and suggested a prompt-normalization strategy (strip vendor tokens, canonicalize function schemas).

Cost sensitivity: daily token burn is high during peak hours; finance wants predictable unit economics before committing to Dedicated. They liked Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching + KV cache.

Security & compliance: require SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 13 months, KMS integration (customer-managed keys preferred), and EU data residency for EU user subsets. Legal will review security packet (drive link shared).

Operational: plan to A/B route 10% of staging traffic to Hosted during POC, then 100% staging if no regressions. For production they want Dedicated with canary rollback and automatic fallback to Hosted in case of capacity issues.

Open action items (short):
- SE (Diego) to deliver compatibility checklist + pre-built prompt-parity tests by 12/16.
- Maya to confirm budget cadence and PO template with finance (due 12/20).
- Helmstone infra to provide example prompts + function schemas to run regression harness (dropbox/drive link).
- Legal to start data residency & KMS paperwork review (linked doc).

Misc: customer asked about livedemo showing quantized model variants and impact on token-level cost — follow up with cost delta examples.

CRM shorthand: POC blue-green, parity-first, Dedicated if ARR thresholds met. Very pragmatic team, engineering-led purchasing.
